record.one_liner: Apify is a cloud platform for running web scraping and automation tools (Actors) with a REST API and an official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: Static API token created in Apify Console (Integrations page), sent as Bearer token in the Authorization header (recommended) or as a URL token parameter. OAuth is offered only for the hosted MCP server, not for the REST API. critic: confirmed.
record.access_notes: Free plan with no credit card required; the free plan includes usage credits and API tokens. Free-plan users are blocked from platform services when prepaid usage runs out until the next billing cycle. critic: confirmed self_serve_free.
record.api_notes: REST API at api.apify.com/v2 covering Actors runs, datasets, key-value stores, and more. Official JS and Python API clients also exist.
record.blocker_notes: critic: confirmed; official hosted MCP at mcp.apify.com on vendor docs and github.com/apify/apify-mcp-server.
